today.title: Workout
today.emptyDescription: Tell us what equipment you have. Workouts adapt to wherever you are.
today.keepGoing: Pick up where you left off

plan.title: Plan
plan.setupDescription: A 4–5 week block that gets harder every week and ends with a recovery week. Exercises adapt to wherever you train.
plan.newPlanConfirm: Start a new plan? The current one will end.
plan.completeDescription: Great work. Create your next block in the Plan tab.
plan.areasHint: Optional, up to 3. They get more volume and are the last to go when time is short.
plan.areasMax: Up to {{max}} areas. Tap a chosen one to remove it.

history.title: History
history.emptyDescription: Your workouts and your progress will show up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.showRirHint: Reps-in-reserve numbers, for people who know them.
settings.backupHint: A file with all your workouts. Importing merges it with what you have and never deletes anything.
settings.backupInvalid: This file isn't a Progrex backup (or it's from a newer version of the app).
settings.resetHint: Deletes your workouts, plan, places and the exercises you created, and takes you back to the first screen. Language and appearance stay.
settings.resetConfirm: Erase everything and start over? Your workouts, plan and places will be gone. To keep a copy, export your data first.

workout.empty: Add your first exercise to get started.

bodyweight_squat: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Sit your hips back, knees tracking over your toes.
Heels down and chest up the whole way.
assisted_pistol_squat: Hold a support in front of you, just for balance.
Lower on one leg, the other straight out in front.
Use your hands as little as possible to stand up.
pistol_squat: On one leg, the other straight out in front.
Arms forward for balance; lower slowly.
Heel down, knee in line with your foot.
goblet_squat: Hold the dumbbell at your chest, elbows down.
Sit down between your knees, torso tall.
Push the floor away with your whole foot.
kettlebell_goblet_squat: Hold the kettlebell by the horns, at your chest.
Sit down between your knees, torso tall.
Push the floor away with your whole foot.
leg_press: Back and hips against the seat the whole time.
Lower until your knees are at about 90°.
Push through your whole foot without locking your knees.
back_squat: Bar on your upper back, not your neck.
Brace your core and sit your hips back.
Knees over toes; chest up on the way up.
front_squat: Bar on the front of your shoulders, elbows high.
Keep your torso as upright as you can.
Keep your elbows up so the bar doesn't roll.
single_leg_rdl: On one leg, knee slightly bent.
Tip forward as the other leg goes back, in one line.
Flat back; squeeze your glute to stand up.
sliding_leg_curl: Lie down, heels on a towel or slider.
Lift your hips and keep them up.
Pull your heels in, then slide them out slowly.
nordic_curl: Kneel with your feet held down.
Straight from knees to head; lower as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands and come back up.
band_good_morning: Band under your feet and behind your neck.
Knees slightly bent; push your hips back.
Flat back; squeeze your glutes to stand up.
dumbbell_rdl: Dumbbells by your legs, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back until you feel your hamstrings.
Flat back; drive your hips forward to stand.
single_leg_dumbbell_rdl: On one leg, dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Tip forward as the other leg goes back, in one line.
Flat back; hips square to the floor.
kettlebell_swing: The power comes from your hips, not your arms.
Hike the bell between your legs with a flat back.
Snap your hips forward; your arms just follow.
leg_curl_machine: Knees at the edge of the pad, roller above your heels.
Curl your heels towards your glutes.
Lower slowly without lifting your hips.
barbell_rdl: Bar against your legs, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back until you feel your hamstrings.
Flat back; the bar slides down your legs.
deadlift: Bar over mid-foot, close to your shins.
Flat back and chest up before you pull.
Push the floor away; hips and knees straighten together.
reverse_lunge: Step back and lower straight down.
Back knee almost touching the floor.
Push through your front foot to come back.
step_up: Whole foot on the bench or step.
Drive up with the top leg, not the bottom one.
Step down slowly and under control.
split_squat: One foot forward, one back, well apart.
Lower straight down until the back knee nearly touches.
Keep most of your weight on the front foot.
bulgarian_split_squat: Back foot on a bench or chair.
Lower straight down, torso leaning slightly forward.
Push through your front foot to stand.
dumbbell_walking_lunge: A dumbbell in each hand, arms straight.
Big step forward; lower until the back knee nearly touches.
Push off and step through with the other leg.
dumbbell_bulgarian_split_squat: Back foot on a bench, dumbbells at your sides.
Lower straight down, torso leaning slightly forward.
Push through your front foot to stand.
incline_push_up: Hands on a bench or table, shoulder-width apart.
Body straight from heels to head.
Bring your chest to the edge and push away.
push_up: Hands under your shoulders, body straight.
Lower until your chest nearly touches the floor.
Elbows about 45° from your body, not flared.
decline_push_up: Feet on a bench or chair, hands on the floor.
Body straight; don't let your hips drop.
Lower your chest close to the floor and push.
archer_push_up: Lower towards one side; the other arm stays straight.
dip: Arms straight on the bars, shoulders down.
Lower until your elbows are at about 90°.
Lean slightly forward; push all the way up.
band_chest_press: Band anchored behind you at chest height.
dumbbell_floor_press: Lie on the floor, knees bent.
Lower until your elbows touch the floor.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
machine_chest_press: Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest.
Back against the pad; press forward.
Return slowly without letting the stack touch.
dumbbell_bench_press: Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest.
Press up without clanking them together.
barbell_bench_press: Shoulder blades together, feet planted, eyes under the bar.
pike_push_up: Hips high, body in an upside-down V.
Lower your head between your hands.
Push the floor away until your arms are straight.
elevated_pike_push_up: Feet on a bench, hips high over your hands.
Lower your head close to the floor.
Push until your arms are straight.
handstand_push_up: Handstand with your feet against a wall.
Lower your head slowly close to the floor.
Push until your arms are straight. Only with good control.
band_overhead_press: Band under your feet, hands at your shoulders.
Press overhead until your arms are straight.
Brace your core; don't arch your back.
dumbbell_shoulder_press: Press overhead until your arms are straight.
Brace your core; don't arch your back.
machine_shoulder_press: Set the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Back against the pad; press up.
kettlebell_press: Bell resting on your forearm, by your shoulder.
Do all the reps on one arm, then the other.
barbell_overhead_press: Bar resting on the front of your shoulders.
Move your head back and press straight up.
Squeeze your core and glutes; don't arch.
towel_door_row: Towel around the handle of a firmly closed door.
Lean back with your body straight.
Pull your chest to your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades.
table_row: Lie under a sturdy table, holding the edge.
Body straight from heels to shoulders.
Pull your chest to the table and lower slowly.
suspension_row: Hold the handles and lean back.
Pull your chest to your hands, elbows close.
band_row: Band anchored in front of you at chest height.
Pull your elbows back, close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then return slowly.
dumbbell_row: One hand on the bench, flat back.
Pull the dumbbell to your hip, elbow close.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
kettlebell_row: Pull the kettlebell to your hip.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
seated_cable_row: Feet on the platform, knees slightly bent.
Pull the handle to your belly, chest up.
Squeeze your shoulder blades and return slowly.
barbell_row: Pull the bar to your belly.
band_pulldown: Pull your elbows down to your sides.
Squeeze your back and return slowly.
negative_pull_up: Start at the top, chin over the bar (jump or use a step).
Lower as slowly as you can.
All the way down to straight arms.
band_assisted_pull_up: Band looped on the bar, under your feet or knees.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
chin_up: Pull until your chin clears the bar.
pull_up: Palms facing away, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Drive your elbows down until your chin clears the bar.
lat_pulldown: Pull the bar to your chest, elbows down.
dead_bug: On your back, arms up, knees at 90°.
Slowly reach one arm and the opposite leg out.
Lower back pressed into the floor throughout.
plank: Forearms down, elbows under your shoulders.
Body straight: hips neither high nor sagging.
Squeeze your core and glutes, and breathe.
side_plank: On your side, elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips until your body is straight.
hollow_hold: On your back, lower back pressed down.
Lift shoulders and legs, arms reaching back.
The lower your legs, the harder it gets.
hanging_knee_raise: Hang from the bar without swinging.
Bring your knees up to your chest.
pallof_press: Stand side-on to where the band is anchored.
Press your hands straight out from your chest.
cable_crunch: Kneel with the rope by your head.
Curl your torso down, squeezing your abs.
band_curl: Elbows pinned to your sides; curl to your shoulders.
dumbbell_curl: Curl to your shoulders, palms up.
hammer_curl: Elbows pinned to your sides; curl to your shoulders.
cable_curl: Elbows pinned to your sides; curl to your shoulders.
barbell_curl: Elbows still; curl to your shoulders.
bench_dip: Hands on the edge of a bench or chair behind you.
Lower until your elbows are at about 90°.
Hips close to the bench; push until straight.
diamond_push_up: Elbows close to your body as you lower.
Body straight from heels to head.
band_pushdown: Elbows pinned to your sides; push down.
dumbbell_overhead_extension: Dumbbell overhead, held with both hands.
Lower it behind your head, elbows pointing up.
Straighten your arms without moving your elbows.
cable_pushdown: Push the handle down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly without moving your elbows.
band_lateral_raise: Raise your arms out to the sides, to shoulder height.
dumbbell_lateral_raise: Raise your arms out to the sides, to shoulder height.
cable_lateral_raise: Stand side-on to the low pulley; pull with the far arm.
Raise your arm out to the side, to shoulder height.
Lower slowly without resting the weight.
calf_raise: Stand with your weight on the balls of your feet.
Rise as high as you can.
Lower slowly until your heels touch the floor.
single_leg_calf_raise: On one leg, a hand on the wall for balance.
Rise as high as you can.
dumbbell_calf_raise: Rise as high as you can.
Lower slowly until your heels touch the floor.
machine_calf_raise: Shoulders under the pads, knees straight.
Rise as high as you can.
Lower until you feel your calves stretch.
glute_bridge: On your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Lift your hips until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glutes at the top; lower slowly.
single_leg_glute_bridge: On your back, one foot down, the other leg up.
Lift your hips, pushing through your heel.
Keep your hips level, no tilting.
dumbbell_hip_thrust: Upper back on a bench, dumbbell on your hips.
Lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top; chin tucked.
barbell_hip_thrust: Upper back on a bench, bar on your hips.
Lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top; chin tucked.

progression.calibrate: First time: pick a weight for {{min}}–{{max}} reps that still leaves {{rir}} in the tank.
progression.calibrateNoLoad: First time: do {{min}}–{{max}} reps and stop with {{rir}} still in the tank.
progression.load: You hit the top of the range on every set. Go up to {{weight}} kg.
progression.load_down: Last time was too heavy. Drop to {{weight}} kg.
progression.rest: Same reps, with {{rest}} s of rest.
progression.tempo: Lower slowly: {{seconds}} s on every rep.
progression.variantNone: You've mastered this one here. Keep it and polish your technique.
progression.deload: Recovery week: same weight, fewer sets, don't push to the limit.
progression.hold: Hold today: same as last time.
progression.plateau: You've stalled here. Change the stimulus: try {{exercise}}.
progression.plateauNone: You've stalled here. Keep it and focus on technique; the plan will adjust.

effort.question: How was it?
effort.introBody: After each set, tell us how many more reps you could have done with good form. You don't need to go all out: this is how Progrex knows when to add weight or reps.

progress.title: Progress
progress.indexNoneHelp: Do the same exercise at least twice to see your progress.
progress.legendAway: Filled dot: a week away from your usual place
progress.stimulusNone: No average to compare with yet.
progress.barLegend: Bar: this week · tick: your average
progress.leversHelp: What moved you forward in these {{weeks}} weeks
progress.emptyTitle: Your progress will show up here
progress.emptyDescription: We measure progress by movement, not by machine: bench press at the gym and push-ups at the hotel feed the same line.
progress.howBody: Each exercise is compared only with itself (with weight: estimated 1RM; without: reps you could do). Each movement averages its exercises, and the Index averages the movements. So changing places never breaks the line.

summary.title: Workout done
summary.awayTitle: Away from your usual place, still on track
summary.awayBody: You kept {{pct}}% of your usual stimulus.
summary.defaultBody: Your next session already has new targets.

travel.until: Until {{date}}. The plan adapted to what's there: same stimulus, different exercises.
travel.equivalenceHelp: Compared with the same workout at {{place}}

reasons.pain: {{areas}} pain: we left out what loads it and kept the rest.
reasons.tired: Tired day: same as last time, a bit further from failure.
reasons.comeback: Back after {{days}} days: today is about getting the rhythm back.
reasons.long_break: Back after {{days}} days: an easier re-entry with fewer sets.
reasons.compressed: Busy week: we merged {{count}} workouts into one so you don't fall behind.
reasons.early_deload: Several exercises stalled: today you recover to come back stronger.

adapt.disclaimer: If the pain persists, see a health professional.

quickStart.homeHint: Dumbbells up to 20 kg, bands and a bar
quickStart.goal: What do you want to achieve?
quickStart.later: 60-minute workouts. You can fine-tune everything later in the Plan tab.

startup.otherTabTitle: Progrex is already open in another tab
startup.otherTabBody: In the browser, your data can only be open in one place at a time. Close the other tab and try again.
startup.errorBody: Your workouts are still saved. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart the app.
